front.en: Basis of the modern Periodic Table

back.en: The number of occupied electron shells
1–2 valence e⁻ → Group 1–2. 3–8 valence e⁻ → Group 13–18 (add 10)
back.bm: 1–2 e⁻ valens → Kumpulan 1–2. 3–8 e⁻ valens → Kumpulan 13–18 (tambah 10)

back.en: Left gaps for undiscovered elements and predicted their properties
back.bm: Meninggalkan ruang kosong untuk unsur belum ditemui dan meramal sifatnya

back.en: Arranged elements by proton number using X-ray studies (1913)
back.bm: Menyusun unsur mengikut nombor proton melalui kajian sinar-X (1913)

back.en: Full outer shell (duplet for He, octet for others) — no need to gain, lose or share electrons
back.bm: Petala luar penuh (duplet bagi He, oktet bagi yang lain) — tidak perlu menerima, melepas atau berkongsi elektron

back.en: Metal hydroxide (alkali) + hydrogen gas, e.g. 2Na + 2H₂O → 2NaOH + H₂
back.bm: Hidroksida logam (alkali) + gas hidrogen, cth. 2Na + 2H₂O → 2NaOH + H₂

back.en: Bigger atoms, lower melting point, MORE reactive
back.bm: Atom lebih besar, takat lebur lebih rendah, LEBIH reaktif

back.en: Cl₂ + H₂O ⇌ HCl + HOCl (two acids); HOCl bleaches
back.bm: Cl₂ + H₂O ⇌ HCl + HOCl (dua asid); HOCl melunturkan

back.en: Bigger atoms, darker colour, higher boiling point, LESS reactive
back.bm: Atom lebih besar, warna lebih gelap, takat didih lebih tinggi, KURANG reaktif

back.en: Basic (Na₂O, MgO) → amphoteric (Al₂O₃) → acidic (SiO₂, P₄O₁₀, SO₂, Cl₂O₇)
back.bm: Bes (Na₂O, MgO) → amfoterik (Al₂O₃) → asid (SiO₂, P₄O₁₀, SO₂, Cl₂O₇)

back.en: Coloured compounds, catalysts, several oxidation numbers, form complex ions
back.bm: Sebatian berwarna, mangkin, beberapa nombor pengoksidaan, membentuk ion kompleks

back.en: He: balloons, airships. Ne: advertising lights. Ar: light bulbs, welding shield
back.bm: He: belon, kapal udara. Ne: lampu iklan. Ar: mentol, pelindung kimpalan
